description.narrative:
Projektet ska öka effektiviteten i DPG:s stöd till Etiopiens utvecklingsmål genom förbättrad koordinering och konsekvent tillämpning av principerna för effektivt utvecklingssamarbete:
-Nationellt ägarskap -Inkluderande partnerskap -Resultatfokus -Ömsesidig ansvarsskyldighet och transparens

The project will enhance the effectiveness of the development partner groups, DPG’s support for Ethiopia’s development objectives by improving coordination and applying the principles of effective development cooperation:
-National ownership -Inclusive partnerships -Results-oriented approach -Mutual accountability and transparency

The support to the DPG is expected to contribute to the following strategic goals, outcomes and outputs:
Strategic Objective:
Official Development Assistance in Ethiopia contributes, as a complement to other financing sources, to the effective implementation of the National Development Plan and the Sustainable Development Goals.
Project Outcomes:
1) Increased alignment and commitment to national development priorities by the DPG is guaranteed. 2) Transparency enhanced, and data increasingly used for effective decision making. 3) Coherent, effective and accountable policy dialogue framework.
Project Outputs:
1) Strengthened national capacity to agree through a participatory manner on and communicate national (and sub-national) development priorities through a streamlined/coherent planning framework. 2) Enhanced use and quality of development and financial data for GoE and DPG decision-making, alignment of investments to national development priorities, effective coordination across the Humanitarian-Development-Peace continuum, and diversification of financial sources for development. 3) Well managed, efficient, inclusive and strategically focused DGP structure and Secretariat.
Cross-cutting objectives
Promote gender equality and integrate a gender perspective in planning and accountability. Strengthen coordination across the humanitariandevelopmentpeace nexus. Support Ethiopias strategy for sustainable financing to diversify funding sources.
